home.title: Shani Mandal Temple
home.subtitle: A Sacred Sanctuary in Nandurbar
home.description: Located in the heart of Nandurbar, Maharashtra, Shani Mandal Temple is a revered place of worship dedicated to Lord Shanidev. Our temple welcomes devotees from all walks of life to seek blessings, find peace, and connect with the divine.
home.aboutText: Shani Mandal Temple has been a beacon of spiritual light for our community. We invite you to experience the divine presence and participate in our daily prayers and special ceremonies.

history.title: Temple History
history.subtitle: A Legacy of Faith and Devotion
history.establishmentText: The Shani Mandal Temple was established decades ago by devoted villagers who sought to create a sacred space for worshiping Lord Shanidev. The temple has since become a cornerstone of spiritual life in Tal. Nandurbar.
history.significanceText: Lord Shanidev is revered as the deity who bestows justice and teaches life lessons through discipline and patience. Devotees visit the temple to seek his blessings for protection from adversities and to find strength during challenging times.
history.architectureText: The temple features traditional architecture that reflects the rich cultural heritage of Maharashtra. The sanctum sanctorum houses a beautiful idol of Lord Shanidev, and the premises are adorned with elements that create a serene and devotional atmosphere.
history.communityText: Beyond spiritual services, our temple actively participates in community welfare activities, organizes festivals, and provides a space for cultural gatherings that strengthen the bonds within our village community.
